title: Focused PU learning from imbalanced data
abstract: arXiv:2605.14467v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a new method of learning from positive and unlabeled (PU) examples in highly imbalanced datasets. Many real-world problems, such as disease gene identification, targeted marketing, fraud detection, and recommender systems, are hard to address with machine learning methods, due to limited labeled data. Often, training data comprises positive and unlabeled instances, the latter typically being dominated by negative, but including also several positive instances. While PU learning is well-studied, few methods address imbalanced settings or hard-to-detect positive examples that resemble negative ones. Our approach uses a focused empirical risk estimator, incorporating both positive and unlabeled examples to train binary classifiers. Empirical evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on imbalanced datasets under two labeling mechanisms - selecting positives completely at random (SCAR) and selecting at random (SAR).

translated_title: 从不平衡数据中进行聚焦式PU学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种在高度不平衡数据集中从正例和未标注（PU）样本中学习的新方法。许多现实世界的问题，如疾病基因识别、定向营销、欺诈检测和推荐系统，由于标注数据有限，难以用机器学习方法解决。通常，训练数据由正例和未标注实例组成，后者通常以负例为主，但也包含一些正例实例。虽然PU学习已被广泛研究，但很少有方法能够应对不平衡设置或难以检测的与负例相似的正例。我们的方法使用聚焦经验风险估计器，结合正例和未标注样本来训练二分类器。实证评估表明，在两种标注机制下——完全随机选择正例（SCAR）和随机选择（SAR）——该方法在不平衡数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于聚焦经验风险估计器的PU学习方法，能够在高度不平衡数据集上、在SCAR和SAR两种标注机制下实现最先进的分类性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a PU learning method based on a focused empirical risk estimator that achieves state-of-the-art performance on highly imbalanced datasets under both SCAR and SAR labeling mechanisms.
